description: ELIGIBILITY - Tackle::vf2 0x143f7ca30 switches on the player's CURRENT action kind via the byte table at 0x143f7cae0. Stagger (kind 0x10) currently maps to case 3 = refuse outright, so the cancel gate is never even asked. Case 1 is the 'ask the current action's vf14' handler. One byte => a stumbling player may turn back and tackle as soon as the stagger's FIRST cancel keyframe passes (kind 0x0d takes the early path). Emulated: Tackle canStart(cur=Stagger) REFUSE -> GATED(vf14).

patches.name: Tackle::vf2 case table: currentKind Stagger -> ask the cancel gate
